body.statement: For every \(\omega\in\Omega(W,\mathcal G,\ell)\), all pivots in \(\Delta_{\omega}\) are nonzero, \(Q_{\omega}\) is unit lower triangular in group order, and \(M_{\omega}\) obtained from \(A_{\omega},B^{C}_{\omega},D_{\omega},B^{L}_{\omega}\) is a legal canonical reconstruction whose retained mixing matrix is exactly \(W\). The construction is invariant to independent nonzero rescaling of the columns of \(W\).
body.justification: Choice-specific pivot normalization is required before any mixing-column ratio can represent a labeled intervention effect.
body.gap: Yang et al.'s Algorithm 2 reconstructs from a chosen row and column assignment, but its displayed formulas do not isolate the column-rescaling invariant normalization used by the proposed effect image.
body.consumer: Every subsequent image value and countermodel is computed from this legal normalized reconstruction.
